description: Unified public registry of all BASED NUT ecosystem pools on Base mainnet: legacy venue pools (Uniswap V2/V3, Aerodrome, Balancer V2, Sudoswap, MintClub bonding curves) + ROOTSTOCK V3 pools. Every pool_address (and bond_contract where the venue is a bonding curve) verified on-chain via eth_getCode.
notes: Two distinct contracts share the name Based Peanut Whorl (symbol pNUT): the original Balancer V3 whorl 0x252b1e49d1d1e42657d028703e8c37fe5b5cacf5 (legacy scope) and the ROOTSTOCK-registry whorl 0xf64ae6f64be7c223092c399dfd2e388db5e16080 (rootstock scope). Both are live and tracked separately.
